title: Integrated skills - English for economics and business 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and use approximately 1000 English vocabulary and phrases related to economics at pre-intermediate level.

Understand and correctly use grammatical structures in economic discourse such as Simple Present, Present Continuous, Present Perfect, Simple Past, Future, time clauses, direct-indirect speech, conditional sentences, passive voice.
Listen and understand dialogues and interviews about topics like job changes, stress management, corporate events, new businesses, marketing strategies.
Participate in conversations, discussions, presentations, negotiations, and telephoning exercises.
Read and understand articles with lengths around 250-300 words on topics such as careers, companies, selling techniques, stress management, corporate events, new businesses, marketing strategies.
Write emails, letters, proposals, reports, and summaries on various business topics.
Analyze situations and solve problems using critical thinking skills.
Work effectively in groups, participate in group activities, and complete group assignments.
Develop self-directed learning skills through independent study and group work.
Prepare and deliver presentations on specific business topics.
Practice negotiation skills in various business scenarios.
Write professional emails and letters in English.
Write business reports on specific topics.
Understand and use basic business terminology in English.
Learn about career moves, online image awareness, and job change processes.
Describe companies and their operations in English.
Understand and apply sales techniques in business contexts.
Understand and discuss marketing strategies and campaigns.
Understand and discuss stress management techniques in business environments.
Understand and discuss corporate events and social activities.
Understand and discuss new business concepts and ideas.
